title: Abubatsi b'iminara .
intro: Mu bihe vya kera cane, haradutse ubutekerezi bukomeye, butandukanye n’ibikorwa vy’ubwubatsi bitangaje be n’inkomezi ziteye ubwoba. Iryo shirahamwe ry’abantu bose ryarahawe ubutunzi bwinshi be n’ububasha bwo ku mubiri, yamara rero bahisemwo inzira yo gutera umugongo ubutumwa bw’Imana bwarungitswe kugira ngo bubayobore. Inkuru yabo iratanga icigwa gikomeye cane mu bitabu vy’amateka, iratanga igihe c’ingaruka zo kwanka ukuri.
clues: Twarahawe inkomezi nyinshi cane zo ku mubiri be n’uburebure, bitandukanye n’abandi bantu bose bo mu gihe cacu.
Twari tuzwi ko twubaka ibibanza bininibinini be n’inkingi zihanitse ahantu hose h’agaciro, twiyumvira ko tuzobaho ibihe bidahera.
Intumwa ivuye muri twebwe yararungitswe kutugabisha, iduhamagarira gusenga Allah wenyene no guheba ibigirwamana vyacu.
Twarabajije intumwa yacu n’ubwibone, tubaza nimba baje iwacu gusa kugira ngo badusenge Allah, duhebe ivyo ba sogokuruza basenga.
Igihugu cacu cari carahezagiwe n’amatongo, amasôko n’imirima myiza, mugabo twabona ko uguterimbere kwacu kwavuye ku bubasha bwacu bwite, atari ku Muremyi wacu.
Kubera ukutemera kwacu n’ugutwenga kwacu gukomeye, amaherezo twaratikijwe n’umuyaga uteye ubwoba kandi w’uburake wamara imisi myinshi n’amajoro menshi.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Gutera intambwe yo gusohora ama surah cumi nka Korowani .
Kugabishwa n’umuhanuzi ku bijanye n’umwuzure uriko uraza .
Kwanka umuhanuzi yagabishije ku bijanye no kwubaka birenze urugero no gusenga ibigirwamana .
trial.answer: Kwanka umuhanuzi yagabishije ku bijanye no kwubaka birenze urugero no gusenga ibigirwamana .

arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verse: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs. (41:15)
